requirements.title: The agent commands are callable in-process by both binaries
requirements.rationale: The worker must run the same triage and fix code af runs, and package main cannot be imported.

criteria.action: keep its commands, flags, help text, envelopes, exit codes, events and --schema output unchanged after every command implementation (triage and fix loops, ring-1, submit and land commands, schemas) moves from cmd/af into one importable internal package, with cmd/af/main.go keeping only main, the ldflags variables and building the toolio.App from that package
criteria.contract: make check passes, the existing af tests pass, and cmd/af/testdata/schema.golden.json is byte-identical

setup: every command implementation has moved from cmd/af into the importable package
cmd/af/main.go holds only main, the ldflags variables and the toolio.App construction
check.pseudocode: out = run('af triage --schema'); assert out == golden['triage']; assert exit('make check') == 0

criteria.condition: an in-process caller supplies, per invocation, a forge client factory, a box provider registry (which may hold providers af does not offer), a brain registry, brain options (model and environment lookup), a git runner, earlier questions, a post-push step or measuring seams
criteria.action: use each supplied value in place of the package-level variables and the process environment, and use af's current value for each one not supplied
criteria.contract: an invocation whose environment lookup yields nothing reads no AF_MODEL, AF_SANDBOX or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from the process environment

setup: the process environment holds AF_MODEL=other, AF_SANDBOX=bogus and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sentinel
an in-process caller supplies a forge factory, a box registry with a provider af does not offer, a brain registry, brain options whose environment lookup yields nothing, and a git runner
an in-process caller supplies none of the seams
check.pseudocode: t.Setenv('AF_MODEL','other'); inv = Invocation{Getenv: empty, Forge: spy, Registry: reg, Git: spyRunner}; run(inv); assert spy.called && reg.used && seenModel != 'other'

criteria.condition: an in-process caller supplies earlier questions for the --context values
criteria.action: render a value given with a question in the brief as the question, its options and the answer; render a value given with no question as material from a person; search no run directory; and, in triage, use the question of the last value that has one
criteria.contract: the envelope carries no question_not_found warning

setup: context values ["ctx1", "ans1"] where ctx1 has no question and ans1 has a question with options A and B
a clone with no .agent-fox/run directories
three context values where the first and second carry questions Q1 and Q2 and the third carries none
check.pseudocode: brief = build(ctx=[c1,a1], earlier=[nil,q1]); assert 'material from a person' in brief; assert q1.text in brief; assert no warning('question_not_found')

criteria.condition: a command is invoked in-process
criteria.action: install no signal handler, treat the caller's context as the only stop, and still apply --timeout and the grace period
criteria.contract: sending SIGHUP or SIGTERM to the process does not cancel the invocation

setup: an in-process toolio invocation whose command blocks until its context ends
check.pseudocode: go run(); syscall.Kill(pid,SIGHUP); assert !done; cancel(); assert done within grace

criteria.condition: an in-process caller supplies an event sink
criteria.action: deliver every event line to the sink as the line is written, in addition to writing it to the run directory's events.jsonl
criteria.contract: the sink receives the same lines, in the same order, as events.jsonl

setup: an invocation with an event sink

criteria.condition: an in-process caller supplies a run id
criteria.action: name the run directory with that id and set it as the envelope's run_id, and reject an id that does not match YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_<6 hex> before creating any run directory
criteria.contract: envelope run_id equals the supplied id; a malformed id returns a usage error and no run directory exists

setup: a valid run id 20250102_030405_abc123 and a malformed id 'run-1'

criteria.condition: an in-process caller supplies a target repository including its host
criteria.action: build the forge client for that repository and use it as the command's repository for every input kind, in place of --repo and the origin of --dir, and treat an issue URL on another repository as a usage error
criteria.contract: an issue URL on another repository gives a usage envelope and no forge request

setup: a target repository host/owner/name and a --dir whose origin is another host

criteria.action: for any two invocations running at the same time in one process, each with its own App, set or read no process environment variable on behalf of an invocation, change no working directory, and write no package-level variable
criteria.contract: both invocations complete under go test -race with no data race reported

setup: two Apps built independently with their own seams
check.pseudocode: for a,b in gen_pairs(): go run(a); go run(b); wait; assert cwd == before; assert envReads == 0

requirements.title: The hub client covers every call an attempt makes
requirements.rationale: Only the hub client knows hub's paths and field names, so every attempt call goes through it.

criteria.action: provide the calls: read the workspace record (clone URL, base branch, mode standard or carry_patch, forge repository URL) via GET /api/v1/workspaces/{slug}; read resolved variables via GET …/vars/resolved; open a session via POST /api/v1/sessions {workspace_slug, archetype, model, run_id}; post usage via POST /api/v1/sessions/{id}/usage; complete a session via POST /api/v1/sessions/{id}/complete; post an events batch via POST …/runs/{run_id}/events/batch; lease via POST …/sandboxes; release via DELETE …/sandboxes/{id}; publish a branch via POST …/branches/{branch}/push; each made with the subscription's PAT, with the path-escaped slug, and touching no identity or visibility cache
criteria.contract: fakehub records each call at its route with the PAT and the escaped slug

setup: fakehub with a workspace whose slug needs path escaping
a hub client with warm identity and visibility caches
check.pseudocode: for call in calls: call(client, pat, slug); r = fake.Requests(); assert r.path == expected && r.auth == pat

criteria.action: bound every request to 10 seconds unless the context is shorter, read at most 1 MiB of any answer, follow no redirect, and put no token in any error value or message
criteria.contract: a delayed answer fails after 10 s as unavailable; a 3xx answer is not followed; err.Error() never contains the PAT

setup: a hub client with an injectable clock and fakehub routes that delay, redirect with 302, or answer 2 MiB
fakehub failing each call with 401, 403, 404, 422, 500, a hangup and a timeout, and a PAT 'pat-secret-xyz'
check.pseudocode: for e in errs: assert 'pat-secret-xyz' not in fmt.Sprintf('%+v', e)

criteria.condition: the client sends a lease request or a branch push route request
criteria.action: bound the request to 5 minutes, or the attempt's context when that is shorter, instead of 10 seconds, and classify a timeout as unavailable
criteria.contract: a lease answered after 30 s succeeds; a timed-out lease returns an unavailable error

setup: fakehub delaying the lease answer 30 s and a second lease route delaying beyond 5 minutes, with a fake clock

criteria.action: classify each answer so callers distinguish it without parsing text: 401 refused; 403 forbidden, with a message naming the hub operation, saying the subscription's PAT lacks the scope for it, and pointing to PUT /api/v1/workspaces/{slug}; 404 not found; any other 4xx rejected, carrying hub's message from {error: {code, message}} when present; 429, 5xx, a transport error, a timeout or a body that is not the expected JSON unavailable
criteria.contract: errors.Is / errors.As on the returned error identify refused, forbidden, not found, rejected and unavailable

setup: fakehub answering 401, 403, 404, 400, 422 with an {error:{code,message}} body, 429, 500, a transport error and non-JSON

criteria.condition: hub answers the workspace-record read with 403
criteria.action: classify the answer as forbidden, not as not found
criteria.contract: the returned error is forbidden and its message points to PUT /api/v1/workspaces/{slug}

setup: fakehub answering GET /api/v1/workspaces/{slug} with 403
check.pseudocode: err = client.WorkspaceRecord(...); assert errors.Is(err, ErrForbidden) && !errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound)

criteria.condition: hub answers a sandbox release with 404
criteria.action: treat the lease as released
criteria.contract: the release returns a nil error

setup: fakehub answering DELETE …/sandboxes/{id} with 404

criteria.action: keep hub's JSON field names inside the hub client package, and decode resolved variables given either as {"vars": {NAME: value}} or as a list of {name, value}
criteria.contract: both forms decode to the same name-to-value map

setup: fakehub serving vars either as {"vars":{...}} or as a list of {name,value}
check.pseudocode: for m in gen_maps(): assert decode(objForm(m)) == decode(listForm(m)) == m

requirements.title: Every forge read and write goes through hub
requirements.rationale: The worker holds no forge token, so the loops' forge seam must be backed by hub's forge API.

criteria.action: implement issuex.Client bound to one workspace slug and its PAT, with a factory of toolio.App.NewForge's signature, mapping Authenticated to true, GetRepository to the workspace record, and ReadIssue (issue and comments), ListComments, UpdateIssue (body and title), CreateIssue, AddComment, AddLabels, RemoveLabel and CreatePullRequest (POST …/pulls {title, body, head, base, draft}) to hub's forge API under /api/v1/workspaces/{slug}
criteria.contract: each method sends exactly one request at the mapped hub route and decodes the answer into the issuex type

setup: a hub forge client bound to a slug and PAT, and fakehub with issue 42 and comments

criteria.condition: a factory call, ref or repo names a repository other than the workspace's forge repository, comparing host, owner and name without case
criteria.action: fail before any request is sent
criteria.contract: an error saying the issue is not on the workspace's repository; fakehub records no request

setup: a client for host/owner/name

criteria.condition: a repo or ref has an empty host
criteria.action: take it to be on the workspace's host and compare it on owner and name alone
criteria.contract: owner/name matching the workspace's repository is accepted

setup: a workspace repository on github.com

criteria.condition: ReadIssue reads an issue that hub reports is a pull or merge request
criteria.action: mark the returned issue as a pull request so the loops' existing pull-request refusal applies
criteria.contract: IssueThread.Issue.IsPR is true

setup: fakehub issues, one reported as a pull request and one as a merge request

criteria.action: report the forge's body limit through issuex.BodyLimiter: GitLab's limit when the repository host is GitLab, GitHub's otherwise
criteria.contract: issuex.MaxBodyLength(client) equals issuex.GitLabMaxBodyLength for a GitLab host

setup: clients for a GitLab host and a GitHub host

criteria.condition: a caller invokes any issuex.Client method not listed in 13-REQ-3.1
criteria.action: send nothing and return an error
criteria.contract: the error says the operation is not available through hub in this release; fakehub records no request

setup: a hub forge client and fakehub

criteria.condition: hub answers a forge call with an error
criteria.action: return the issuex error type the loops already classify: refused or forbidden as *issuex.HTTPError with status 401 or 403 carrying the 13-REQ-2.4 message; not found as issuex's not-found error; 409 as issuex.ErrConflict; 429 as issuex's rate-limited error; any other unavailable answer as a retryable error
criteria.contract: issuex.IsNotFound, issuex.IsRateLimited and errors.Is(err, issuex.ErrConflict) hold for 404, 429 and 409, and the loops yield auth, forge and retryable as with a direct forge

setup: fakehub answering forge calls with 401, 403, 404, 409, 429 and 503

requirements.title: An attempt's settings come from hub variables read at the start of every attempt
requirements.rationale: Hub variables are the only per-workspace configuration the service has, and refusals must happen before anything is spent.

criteria.condition: an attempt starts
criteria.action: read the resolved variables and apply them with these defaults (triage / fix) and ranges: AF_BRAIN_TRIAGE or AF_BRAIN_FIX then AF_BRAIN, default agentkit / claude, accepting agentkit or claude; AF_MODEL, default the catalog's default Anthropic model, any non-empty string; AF_MAX_BUDGET_USD, default 2 / 10, finite and above 0; AF_MAX_TURNS, default 100 / 150, whole number ≥ 1; AF_TIMEOUT, default 15m / 45m, Go duration from 1m to 24h; AF_MAX_ATTEMPTS, default 2, whole number 1 to 10; AF_SANDBOX_PROFILE, default omitted, non-empty; AF_FIX_LAND, default pr, accepting pr, branch, none; taking the default for an unset or empty variable and ignoring unknown variables
criteria.contract: the loop receives the resolved values as flags

setup: variables set to valid boundary values (AF_TIMEOUT 1m and 24h, AF_MAX_ATTEMPTS 1 and 10), empty values, unknown variables, and AF_BRAIN_FIX overriding AF_BRAIN

criteria.condition: a variable's value is outside its accepted range, including AF_BRAIN set to scripted
criteria.action: fail the attempt before a session opens
criteria.contract: a failed envelope with error.category config, retryable false, fix_hint.var naming the variable and a message naming the variable and its value; fakehub records no session request

setup: variables out of range: AF_MAX_BUDGET_USD=0, NaN, AF_MAX_TURNS=0, AF_TIMEOUT=30s and 25h, AF_MAX_ATTEMPTS=11, AF_BRAIN=scripted, AF_FIX_LAND=weird
check.pseudocode: for v in bad: r = run(vars=v); assert r.env.error.category=='config' && !r.env.error.retryable && r.env.fix_hint.var==v.name && fake.Count('POST /sessions')==0

criteria.action: prefix every status label and restored request label with the subscription's label_prefix, and not read AF_LABEL_PREFIX for the prefix
criteria.contract: labels written to fakehub carry the subscription's prefix

setup: a subscription label_prefix 'team:' and AF_LABEL_PREFIX='other:' set in the hub variables, and a run with it unset

criteria.condition: AF_LABEL_PREFIX is set and differs from the subscription's label_prefix
criteria.action: add a warning to the envelope and keep the subscription's prefix
criteria.contract: the envelope's warnings include label_prefix_ignored

criteria.action: run the fix loop with --attempts 1 and return AF_MAX_ATTEMPTS in the attempt's result as the most attempts a round may make
criteria.contract: the result's max-attempts field equals AF_MAX_ATTEMPTS; the fix envelope reports one in-run attempt

setup: AF_MAX_ATTEMPTS=5

criteria.condition: a fix attempt is on a workspace whose mode is carry_patch, or AF_FIX_LAND is patch
criteria.action: refuse the fix before any clone, lease, session, forge write or brain
criteria.contract: a failed envelope with error.category unsupported, retryable false, and a message saying carry-patch landing comes in a later release; fakehub records no clone, lease, session request, label or comment, and no brain runs

setup: a carry_patch workspace, and separately a standard workspace with AF_FIX_LAND=patch, and a counting brain

criteria.condition: a triage attempt is on a workspace whose mode is carry_patch
criteria.action: run the triage as on a standard workspace
criteria.contract: the triage envelope is not an unsupported refusal

setup: a carry_patch workspace and a scripted brain submitting a probable diagnosis

requirements.title: The clone and the only git credential
requirements.rationale: The PAT must reach hub's git server without ever landing on a command line, in a file or in the box.

criteria.action: work only in the subdirectories clone/ and input/ of the attempt directory, each created with mode 0700, and never write, move or remove envelope.json, report.md or the attempt directory itself
criteria.contract: after the attempt returns, the attempt directory exists and the worker created no other entry in it

setup: an attempt directory pre-seeded with envelope.json and report.md with known contents

criteria.condition: the attempt reaches the clone step
criteria.action: clone the workspace's hub clone URL into clone/ with the workspace's base branch checked out, and set the committer identity agent-fox <agent-fox@noreply.invalid> in the clone's local configuration
criteria.contract: git -C clone rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD prints the base branch; user.name is agent-fox and user.email is agent-fox@noreply.invalid

setup: fakehub's loopback git server with a repository whose base branch is 'develop'

criteria.action: pass the PAT to git only as the header Authorization: Basic <base64 of "agent-fox:<PAT>">, set as git configuration scoped to hub's URL through the command's environment, never on a command line, in .git/config or any other file, or in a log, the envelope, the events or a comment
criteria.contract: no argv of any git command and no file under clone/ contains the PAT; the fake git server receives the Basic header

setup: fakehub's git server recording the Authorization header and a recording git runner

criteria.action: run every git command that carries the PAT or can reach a remote (the clone, every git command of the fix pipeline and the push) under a hermetic runner with no global or system git configuration, no prompt and no askpass, while the box's sync and checks.FileView keep the default runner
criteria.contract: a credential helper in the operator's global git configuration is never invoked

setup: a global git config with a credential helper and askpass that write a marker file when invoked
GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT enabled in the environment

criteria.condition: hub's git server refuses the clone's credential with 401 or 403
criteria.action: stop the attempt and mirror it as a failure
criteria.contract: a failed envelope with error.category auth and retryable false

setup: fakehub git server answering the clone with 401, then with 403

criteria.condition: the clone fails for any other reason (a transport error, hub's 5xx, a timeout)
criteria.action: stop the attempt without an envelope
criteria.contract: a transient error carrying *toolio.Failure with category git and retryable true

setup: the git server answering 503, hanging up, or timing out
check.pseudocode: res, err = run(); var f *toolio.Failure; assert errors.As(err,&f) && f.Category=='git' && f.Retryable; assert res == nil

criteria.condition: the attempt returns
criteria.action: remove clone/ and input/, except keep clone/ when the cancellation cause is a shutdown or the attempt returns a transient error
criteria.contract: clone/ is absent after a normal return and present after a shutdown or transient error

setup: attempts ending normally, with a shutdown cause, and with a transient error

criteria.condition: a delivery finds a clone/ kept by an earlier delivery
criteria.action: remove the kept clone/ and clone afresh
criteria.contract: the new clone/ is a fresh clone of the base branch

setup: a clone/ left by an earlier delivery containing a marker file and a stale commit

requirements.title: The lease and the gateway box
requirements.rationale: The box the brain and the measuring run in is hub's, reached through the gateway with the lease token alone.

criteria.condition: every refusal of settings, mode, input and session has passed
criteria.action: request a lease with {purpose: "triage"|"fix", labels: {job, attempt}}, adding profile set to AF_SANDBOX_PROFILE only when that is set, and report the granted sandbox id to the jobs recorder
criteria.contract: fakehub records one lease request with that body; the recorder receives the sandbox id

setup: fakehub granting leases, and runs with AF_SANDBOX_PROFILE set and unset

criteria.condition: hub answers the lease request with 401 or 403
criteria.action: stop the attempt and mirror it as a failure
criteria.contract: a failed envelope with error.category auth and retryable false

setup: fakehub answering the lease with 401, then 403

criteria.condition: hub refuses the lease with any other answer, is unavailable or times out, the gateway cannot be reached or refuses to create the box, or the lease has less than 2 minutes left before expires_at
criteria.action: stop the attempt without an envelope, with hub's reason in the message when hub gave one
criteria.contract: a transient error carrying *toolio.Failure with category sandbox and retryable true

setup: a lease answered 503, a capacity rejection (409) with a reason, a lease timeout, an unreachable gateway, a gateway refusing box creation, and a lease expiring in 90 s

criteria.action: be built from the lease's gateway URL and token in the attempt's own box registry, not offered as an af --sandbox choice, count as isolating, call processes by name from the image, and create the box with the labels af.run_id, af.tool, af.job and af.attempt and an empty Env
criteria.contract: the gateway backend records a spec with those four labels and len(Spec.Env) == 0; af --sandbox gateway is a usage error

setup: a lease pointing at an in-process gateway whose backend records specs

criteria.condition: a brain that needs the vendor key runs in a gateway box
criteria.action: check for no vendor key on the host, send none, and give a process started in the box the names of the brain's credentials as references to the box's own environment, never as values
criteria.contract: the brain starts with no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the worker's environment lookup; the executed command contains NAME="$NAME" and no key value

setup: the worker's environment lookup yields nothing and the process holds ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sentinel

criteria.condition: AF_TIMEOUT would end later than 2 minutes before the lease's expires_at
criteria.action: cut the attempt's timeout so it ends 2 minutes before expires_at
criteria.contract: the loop's --timeout is the cut value and the envelope's warnings include lease_shortened_timeout

setup: AF_TIMEOUT=45m and a lease expiring in 20 minutes, and a lease expiring in 2 hours

criteria.action: release a granted lease after the box is closed on every path (success, failure, transient error, cancellation, shutdown and panic), on a context the attempt's cancellation does not reach, bounded to 30 seconds
criteria.contract: fakehub records one DELETE …/sandboxes/{id} per granted lease, after the box's close

setup: attempts ending in success, failure, transient error, cancel, shutdown and a panic in the loop, with a recording backend

criteria.condition: the lease release fails
criteria.action: keep the envelope's status unchanged and record the failure
criteria.contract: the envelope's warnings include lease_release_failed; under a transient error the failure is logged

setup: fakehub answering the release with 500

requirements.title: In the service, measuring runs in the box
requirements.rationale: Brain-written tests must never run on the worker host, which holds every workspace's sealed PAT.

criteria.condition: a service fix attempt runs
criteria.action: run detection (af lang detect), the baseline and the gate after the change (af gate run) and the revert check (af revert-check) inside the leased box, syncing the host's tree into the box and placing the run's gate table before each run and reading each result from the command's envelope, and never call the host-side gate or revert-check functions
criteria.contract: the gateway backend records each of the four commands as an execution; the host-side gate and revert-check seams record zero calls

setup: a service fix attempt with a gateway backend recording executions and host gate and revert-check seams that count calls

criteria.condition: the first ring-1 command is about to run in a box
criteria.action: run af --version in that box once
criteria.contract: the gateway backend records exactly one af --version per box

setup: a gateway backend recording commands

criteria.condition: af is missing from the box image or af --version fails
criteria.action: end the attempt without running any ring-1 command
criteria.contract: a failed envelope with error.category sandbox, retryable false, and a message naming the profile (AF_SANDBOX_PROFILE, or hub's default) and saying its image must provide af

setup: a backend where af is missing, and another where af --version exits non-zero, with AF_SANDBOX_PROFILE=py

criteria.condition: the box's af reports another version or commit than the worker's
criteria.action: continue the attempt and add a warning
criteria.contract: the envelope's warnings include box_af_version_mismatch

setup: a box af reporting another version/commit than the worker's

criteria.condition: a ring-1 envelope's schema_version has another major version than the worker's, or its result does not decode
criteria.action: end the attempt
criteria.contract: a failed envelope with error.category sandbox, retryable false, naming the profile

setup: a box af answering schema_version with another major, and another answering invalid JSON

criteria.condition: measuring runs in the box
criteria.action: open the box before its preflight's detection and keep that one box for the whole attempt, while the file view, the repository map, path validation, applying the export, the commit and the push stay on the host
criteria.contract: the gateway backend records one box creation per attempt

setup: a backend recording creations and executions in order

criteria.action: keep the verdict table, the brief's gate section and the result fields in the same shape in both modes, and keep measuring on the host under af --local
criteria.contract: af fix --local tests pass unchanged

setup: the same fix scenario run in service mode and under af --local

criteria.condition: a ring-1 command cannot run because the box or the gateway was lost
criteria.action: end the loop with a retryable sandbox failure, which the worker returns as a transient error
criteria.contract: the worker returns a transient error carrying *toolio.Failure with category sandbox and retryable true, and no envelope

requirements.title: The attempt pipeline
requirements.rationale: The worker is what turns a recorded job into a run, and the jobs layer's retry rules depend on transient errors and envelopes being told apart.

criteria.condition: the jobs layer hands the worker an attempt with its contract input plus its round position
criteria.action: run, in order: resolve (PAT from the store, workspace record, variables, and the issue for an issue input); session (open it and report session id and run id to the recorder); mark (set <prefix>in-progress on the issue when there is one); clone; lease and box; run the loop in-process with the hub forge factory, the workspace's forge repository as target, the hermetic git runner, the gateway registry, box-backed measuring, the earlier questions, the session's run id and the settings as flags; mirror; release; report to hub
criteria.contract: fakehub's request log shows session open, in-progress label, clone, lease, loop requests, mirror writes, release, usage, events batch and session complete in that order

setup: fakehub, its git server, the in-process gateway and the scripted brain
check.pseudocode: log = fake.Requests(); assert indexOf('POST /sessions') < indexOf('add in-progress') < indexOf('git clone') < indexOf('POST sandboxes') < indexOf('push') < indexOf('POST pulls') < indexOf('comment') < indexOf('DELETE sandboxes') < indexOf('usage') < indexOf('events/batch') < indexOf('complete')

criteria.condition: an infrastructure failure occurs: hub unavailable when reading the workspace record, variables or issue or opening the session (hub); a clone failing other than on a refused credential (git); a lease or box problem (sandbox); or a loop envelope that is failed with retryable true and category sandbox, forge or hub
criteria.action: return a transient error instead of a result
criteria.contract: a transient error carrying *toolio.Failure with the category, the message and retryable true; no envelope is returned; with the jobs layer's fake retry the same attempt is handed over again

setup: hub 503 on the workspace record, the variables, the issue and the session open, and a loop envelope failed retryable with category sandbox, forge (rate limit) and hub

criteria.action: return a result with an envelope for every other ending (brain-level outcomes including brain and no_result, a push or publish failure after the commit as git not retryable, and permanent refusals config, unsupported, usage, auth and non-retryable sandbox), building the envelope itself for a refusal before the loop with tool triage or fix, status failed or usage for an input refusal, error with retryable false, empty arrays and usage source none, encoded as toolio encodes envelopes; a refused PAT, a forbidden operation and an unreadable or missing subscription token are category auth with a message pointing to PUT /api/v1/workspaces/{slug}
criteria.contract: the built envelope validates against the toolio envelope schema

setup: refusals: config, unsupported, usage (input), auth (refused PAT, forbidden, unreadable token, missing subscription), and a push failure after the commit

criteria.condition: an attempt stops before the loop runs
criteria.action: apply the stop-early rules: a refusal at resolve, hub unavailable at resolve or session, or a 401/403 at session writes nothing to the forge, takes no lease and makes no hub report; a transient clone, lease or box failure removes in-progress, releases a granted lease, posts events and completes the session failed; a refused clone or lease credential mirrors failed with one comment, releases a granted lease, posts events and completes the session failed
criteria.contract: fakehub's request log matches the rule for each stop point

setup: stops at: resolve refusal, hub unavailable at resolve/session, session 401/403, transient clone/lease/box, refused clone or lease credential

criteria.action: turn the input into loop input: an issue number into the forge URL of that issue in the workspace's repository; <path>#<N> or a URL into that issue's URL when its repository matches the workspace's (path compared without case, full namespace on GitLab), else a usage refusal saying the issue is not on the workspace's repository; an issue hub reports is a pull or merge request into a usage refusal before any write; text onto stdin, with a given title as its first line as a Markdown heading; a file written as input/<base name> and passed by path; and --context values as the request's context strings in order then the answers in order, with earlier questions giving no question for each context string and the question with its options for each answer
criteria.contract: refusals return a usage envelope and fakehub records no write; the brief carries each question with its answer and the envelope has no question_not_found warning

setup: a workspace on github.com/Org/Repo and on a GitLab group/sub/project, issue inputs: 42, 'org/repo#42', 'other/repo#42', a URL on this repository, a URL on another, and a pull request
a text input with a title, a file input 'notes.md', context strings [c1,c2] and answers [a1 with question Q1]

criteria.condition: the fix pipeline's push of a branch to hub's git server succeeds
criteria.action: call hub's branch push route for that branch before any pull request is asked for, trying up to 3 times in all while hub is unavailable, and on a final failure end the loop failed with category git, not retryable, keeping the branch on hub's git server

execution_paths.title: A fix attempt on a standard workspace lands a pull request

steps.action: hands the worker a fix attempt on issue 42 with round position 1
reads the PAT, workspace record, variables and issue 42 through hub
opens a hub session and reports its session id and run id to the jobs recorder
sets af:in-progress on issue 42 and clones from hub's git server with the scoped Basic header
leases a box, reports the sandbox id, and creates the gateway box with empty Env
runs detection, baseline, brain and gate inside the box, commits and pushes fix/42-… to hub's git server
calls hub's branch push route, then POST …/pulls
posts one fix_summary comment, sets af:landed and removes af:in-progress
releases the lease, posts usage and an events batch, and completes the session
receives a done envelope with pull request, hub_session and sandbox artifacts and labels af:landed set, af:in-progress removed
